anchor: On a random-effects table for magical headgear, what harmless effect happens on a roll of 57, and how long does it last?
If I reach into magical headwear and come out with something mundane, could it be a vial of acid or a lit torch?
What sixth-level magic slowly turns a creature into a statue over several rounds of failed rolls to resist, and what ends it?
Which sixth-level spell is useless against golems, since those automatically shrug it off, and requires a monster's feather as a material?
Which first-level magic can make a creature fall flat on the ground or let go of what it's holding?
When I need an enemy to scurry away from me next turn, what low-level spell does it with a single spoken word, and what must it roll against?
How can I murmur a private note to one particular creature 120 feet away without anyone else overhearing, and what walls can it pass?
Which cantrip lets me talk through a thin lead sheet or a foot of stone, provided I know the target and it's beyond the barrier?
Which woodland-warrior class gets six ready-to-use magic options and two second-level magic reserves at level five?
At level one, what class starts with two spell choices ready to cast, two chosen monster types to hunt, and a weapon skill ability?
Which enormous brute with 105 hit points knocks foes flat with a heavy swing and leaves them sickened by a hurled object?
Which hulking creature with a strength of 21, a dexterity of 8, and reach of 10 feet understands only one tongue?
Which band of power lets its wearer breathe underwater and swim 60 feet, or walk through solid rock, depending on the plane it's tuned to?
Which wearable item grants immunity to fire damage and a fire-plane language, plus five charges that partly refill at dawn?
Which pendant lets me spend an action to recover 4 to 10 hit points, and gives an edge on rolls to shake off toxins?
I want an uncommon neck item that needs attunement, which I can use once per dawn to mend myself mid-fight.
At character level five, which playable race can sprout spectral wings as a quick extra move to fly for ten minutes?
Which humanoid species gets flight that works like its exhale attack's energy, and needs an extended rest before it's usable again?
At level nine, which barbarian option lets me give up my edge on a heavy attack to shove a foe 15 feet and deal an extra 1d10?
Which hard-hitting option slows a target's walking pace by 15 feet until my next turn, and doesn't stack with another slowdown of its kind?
Which divine caster specialty draws on the benevolent force behind everything that lives, and suits almost any faith?
My priest mends wounds and serves a farm or home deity; which divine specialty fits that concept?
Which flying insect-like beast with 22 hit points and 50-foot flight can sting me with stabbing and toxic harm?
A nearly mindless flier flits out of an enemy's reach without provoking a counterattack and crawls at only 10 feet: what is it?
What touch cantrip lets an ally shrug off a few points of harm from one chosen type, but only once per turn?
Which cantrip requires only gestures and words, and can cover an ally for up to a minute while I keep focus on it?
Which eighth-level magic grows a physical copy of a person over four months in a sealed jar, which a willing spirit may enter on death?
Which spell takes one hour to cast, burns a diamond worth over 1,000 gold, and lets me pick whether the copy is older or younger?
Which third-level spell ends lingering effects of level three or lower on a target within 120 feet, while deeper ones need a check?
If a foe's enduring sorcery is fourth-level or stronger, how do I try to strip it away, and what number must I beat?
Which fiend can raise a frozen barrier when it rolls a 6 to recharge, using its brains instead of components, with a DC 17 spell save?
Which wearable item makes me immune to having my thoughts read, my lies detected, or my alignment revealed?
Which uncommon piece of jewelry can become unnoticeable on command, and if I die while wearing it, my spirit stays inside?
What monk ability turns a successful nimble-reflex roll against an area blast into no harm at all, and cuts failures to half?
At what level does a monk gain the dodge-for-half-damage trick, and does it work when the monk is knocked out of action?
Which tiny flying nuisance with 5 hit points latches onto victims and drains 5 life each turn?
What tiny creature can see 60 feet in total darkness and unhook itself from a target by spending just 5 feet of movement?
Which medium amphibian-like beast breathes air and water, and leaps up to 20 feet long even without a running start?
Which beast can gulp down a Small creature whole, leave it unable to see inside, and corrode it for 2d4 at its next turn's end?
On a random-effect stick, a roll of 46 to 50 unleashes a streak of crackling power in a line from me to a chosen point; which spell?
Which group of tiny crows shrugs off most physical hits and cannot be held, paralyzed, or knocked prone?
What flock of feathered pests can unleash an ear-splitting shriek that leaves a target unable to hear until the flock's next turn?
Which seventh-level magic flips the pull of the ground in a 50-foot-radius column, sending creatures not tethered to it up to hover at its top until it ends?
When a spell upends the earth's pull and I grab something nailed in place, what roll stops me from being yanked upward?
Which third-level summoning creates a Large group of ghostly beasts that lunge at foes passing within 10 feet, dealing 3d10 cutting harm on a failed dodge?
If I stand beside my spirit animal band, what edge do I gain on Strength rolls to resist, and how far can I shift them each turn?
Which faceted jewel with 50 charges can leave a single foe 60 feet away unable to see, or flood a 30-foot cone with light?
I need an item that spills light across a 30-foot circle plus 30 more feet of dimmer glow at no charge cost; what is it?
Which fighter feature lets me use special properties of three kinds of arms I choose, and swap one choice each time I finish an extended rest?
Which large lawful fiend with 199 hit points and 18 armor class revives in its home plane if it dies elsewhere?
Is there a fiend that can hurl fire 150 feet and set burnable goods alight when it hits?
Which prehistoric flying reptile-like beast has 13 hit points and flies 60 feet, and can dodge out of melee reach without a free hit?
A dim-witted flyer with a 1d8+2 bite and only 10 feet of walking speed: which creature is it?
Which secret tongue lets its speakers always have a spell for talking to beasts, and hide messages that others can only spot with a DC 15 check?
Can a nature-caster slip a secret note into view that others can detect but never decipher without magic?
When I take my quick action to enter a fury state, can I also move half my speed as part of it?
What level must a barbarian reach before entering a fury state lets them also cover ground equal to half their speed?
Which 9th-level cleric spell restores up to 700 hit points split among allies within 60 feet and clears sight loss, hearing loss, and toxins?
What ninth-level spell needs only spoken words and gestures, takes one action, and works on creatures I can see?
Which large heavenly creature with 199 hit points sees hidden things out to 120 feet, and imposes disadvantage on attempts to read its intentions?
Which winged lion-like guardian can turn three failed saving rolls into successes per day and shrugs off life-draining and holy harm?
Which three-pronged spear lets its wielder take control of a swimming animal with 3 charges and a DC 15 save?
I want an uncommon, attuned weapon that refills its charges at sunrise by rolling three-sided dice; which one?
What rare footwear that needs attunement lets me cast a float-in-the-air spell on myself?
Which large prehistoric sea reptile with 68 hit points and a 40-foot swim speed can hold its breath for an hour?
Which large swimmer walks at only 20 feet on land, but bites for 11 on a +6 attack?
Which eighth-level spell fills a 60-foot ball within 150 feet with daylight and deals 12d6 holy harm?
What bright area spell cancels magical darkness in its zone and leaves creatures that fail a roll unable to see for a minute?
When I change into a beast as a nature caster, how many temporary HP do I get, and does shifting break focus on an ongoing spell?
Do my mental ability scores and class features stay when my body becomes a beast, and can I still cast spells in that form?
Which tiny aquatic creature has just 1 hit point and bites with an edge against foes already wounded, dealing 1 stabbing damage?
A palm-sized water dweller that breathes only underwater and swims 40 feet but crawls 5 feet on foot: what is it?
Which knowledge skill covers wars, bygone peoples, and certain creatures such as giants and humanoids?
When a puzzle's hidden code or a trap's trigger stumps me, which skill is the one to use?
Which legendary glass orb lets me spy on a distant person and pick up surface thoughts within 30 feet of the sensor with a DC 17 roll?
I want a touch-activated legendary item that doesn't need me to hold focus on its mental probe, and ends when the far-viewing ends; what is it?
